sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Student Placement and Golden Visa Residence Advisory

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (standard international company jurisdiction; no material sub-state tax or corporate law variation; capital: Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law and French civil law heritage, with customary law recognised under the Constitution of Vanuatu (1980); company law codified under the International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as amended)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty (BIT) in force with the United States, the European Union, Australia, or China as of the pre-incorporation filing date; treaty inventory must be re-verified against the UNCTAD IIA Navigator at the filing date (Vanuatu maintains only a very limited BIT network).

PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — in force 13 December 2020; covers trade in goods and services and economic cooperation with Australia, New Zealand, and Pacific Forum members.
World Trade Organization membership — Vanuatu acceded on 24 August 2012.

No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network; exchange of information is pursued through the Vanuatu tax information exchange regime and bilateral tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) with OECD/G20 partners.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as amended), including the UBO identification and registered-agent record-keeping obligations for all International Companies; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 17 of 2014 (as amended); AML/CFT Regulations 2015 (as amended); and the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019. The Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) supervises AML/CFT compliance and receives suspicious transaction reports.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — the beneficial ownership register is maintained by the VFSC and is not publicly searchable; access is restricted to the VFSC, VFIU, Vanuatu law-enforcement agencies, and competent foreign authorities under exchange-of-information requests. Nominee arrangements are permitted, but the ultimate beneficial owner must be declared to the licensed registered agent and filed with the VFSC.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of the passport of each legal person / beneficial owner (as per CDD) — with recent photograph and signatures
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Vanuatu is NOT a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the notarized copy must be authenticated by the issuing state's competent authority and then legalized by the nearest Vanuatu diplomatic or consular mission (or by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs for Vanuatu-issued documents)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / source-of-funds letter confirming financial standing and account opening history
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (bank letter notarized, state-authenticated, and legalized by the Vanuatu consulate or in-country mission; alternatively by chain through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate beneficial owner (where a corporate shareholder holds 25% or more)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same non-Apostille chain as above)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (recent utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (where required by the VFSC registered agent's KYC policy; otherwise a certified copy suffices under the AML/CFT Act CDD rules)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified corporate constitutional documents (memorandum and articles of association) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation, certified by its registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (for foreign public documents used in Vanuatu proceedings)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UK HM Treasury consolidated list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and the VFIU/VFSC domestic designation lists. PEP determination is mandatory for all foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates, triggering enhanced due diligence (EDD), source-of-wealth verification, and senior-management approval before incorporation. Continuous compliance monitoring is required under the AML/CFT Act No. 17 of 2014 (as amended) and VFIU guidance; the risk override for this scope (Immigration and Visa Advisory) is Medium_Risk_Enhanced.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry; name search and reservation are submitted through licensed VFSC registered agents on the official registry platform (www.vfsc.vu; the VFSC e-services portal for company name availability and incorporation filings).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Constitutional official languages are Bislama, English, and French (Constitution of Vanuatu, Article 3(1)). All statutory company names must be in Latin (Roman) script; any non-Latin-script trading name must be transliterated into a Latin-script equivalent and cross-referenced in the constitutional documents. The name must end with an acceptable limited liability designator (e.g., 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Société Anonyme' or its abbreviation) and must not be scandalous, misleading, or contrary to public policy.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Assurance; Bank; Banking; Building Society; Chamber of Commerce; Chartered; Co-operative; Government; Imperial; Insurance; Insurer; Municipal; National; Royal; State; Trust; Trustee; University; and any token implying patronage or endorsement by the Republic of Vanuatu or any head of state
Tokens implying a licensable regulated activity (collective investment schemes, fund management, insurance, banking, fiduciary services) without the corresponding VFSC licence
Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company or reserved name in the Vanuatu registry
Names in Bislama that carry profane, vulgar, or politically sensitive connotations
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: a written request for re-reservation must be lodged with the International Companies Registry through the licensed registered agent before the 30-day reservation expires; re-reservation is granted at the VFSC's administrative discretion. Rejection appeal: if the name is refused, the applicant receives a written notice citing the objection ground; the applicant may (i) file a revised name submission immediately without penalty, or (ii) appeal by written submission to the Registrar of International Companies within 30 days of the rejection notice, setting out why the name is distinctive and compliant with the International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992. If the Registrar upholds the refusal, the applicant may file an application for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the judicial review procedures applicable to statutory registries. Legal counsel should combine the appeal with a fresh alternative name reservation to avoid operational delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the physical address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent, where the statutory registers (members, directors, charges) and AML/CFT files are kept. A virtual office may be used solely as a non-statutory correspondence address for back-office functions; the immigration and visa advisory business model must not rely on a virtual office to satisfy the International Companies Act provisions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate — annual probability of an unannounced VFSC/VFIU verification visit to the licensed registered agent's premises concerning a given IC file is estimated at 8–12%, increasing to approximately 30% where the beneficial owner is fully non-resident, the business is immigration-consulting, and the file is flagged under enhanced risk scoring. Physical inspection of the beneficial owner's overseas premises is not conducted by Vanuatu authorities except through mutual legal assistance or treaty-based exchange mechanisms.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule of the International Companies Registry (per search/reservation filing)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule for International Companies (filing fee plus registration fee; prevailing market range USD 250–320)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year VFSC government maintenance/annual fee (pro-rated at incorporation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual maintenance fee payable per VFSC fee schedule (approximately VUV 36,000; converted at the prevailing VUV/USD rate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office retainer (year 1)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed VFSC registered agent in Port Vila (office rental, statutory records custody, compliance contact)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in the Vanuatu corporate service provider market (range USD 900–1,500 for year 1)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External corporate counsel instructed by the applicant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for offshore corporate drafting (blended hourly/fixed fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: KYC pack compilation and UBO register filing (CDD under the AML/CFT Act No. 17 of 2014)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External corporate counsel and registered agent (file assembly, verification, and UBO declaration to VFSC)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for outsourced AML compliance (fixed fee per client file)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscription/usage charges (UN, OFAC, UK HMT, EU lists)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consulate/notary tariffs; estimated for 3–5 documents inclusive of the certification chain

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing courier tariffs (door-to-door, insured, return tracking)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory contingency reserve (VFSC fee fluctuations, additional legalization copies, bank-certified translations)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained by counsel as disbursement reserve
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prudent budgeting benchmark of 5–6% of projected statutory and professional disbursements

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2013), ss. 2, 4, 6-12, 15-17, 21-23 and 36; read together with the Financial Services (Supervision) Act [Cap 50] and the Companies Act [Cap 191] for service of process and registered office provisions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies and International Trust Registry, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), PMB 002, First Floor, 4 Bay Roc, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company, lodged together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and the registered agent's statutory declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; default authorized share capital is USD 50,000 with no paid-up requirement and no escrowed capital account. However, for the ISIC 7810 scope (client visa and placement monies), the sector licence mandates segregation of client funds in an escrow/trust account held with a Vanuatu-licensed bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that: (1) the subscribers hereby subscribe for, adopt and ratify the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company, and approve the allotment of one fully paid ordinary share of no par value to the founding subscriber; (2) the premises of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila be and are hereby adopted as the registered office; (3) the following persons be and are hereby appointed: [Director A] as first Director, [Director B] as first Director, [Officer A] as Chief Executive Officer, [Officer B] as Company Secretary, and [Officer C] as Money-Laundering Reporting Officer; (4) each shall hold office until the next annual general meeting; and (5) the officers be authorized to execute all filings, licenses, and bank accounts necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trust Registry (online e-Services portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed corporate names through the VFSC online reservation module. The name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must not contain restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance' or 'Assurance' without prior regulatory authorization. Pay the name search/reservation fee and obtain the Name Reservation Certificate before drafting constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Application Form (VFSC Form NR-1)
Passport copy of each proposed director
Authority letter from the licensed registered agent
Restricted-word justification (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file alternate proposed names within 7 days; respond to any Registry query or third-party objection with written submissions within 14 days of notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (corporate services provider in Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act [Cap 222], incorporating provisions on share classes, director powers, indemnity, and the registered agent's consent. Obtain written consents from the registered office provider and each first director, and execute the subscriber's signatures before a notary public.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (original and duplicates)
Consent to act as Registered Office Provider (Form ROC-2)
Consent and Particulars of First Directors (Form CF-3)
Notarized subscriber signature pages
Engagement letter with licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry objects to any constitutional clause, instruct counsel to amend and resubmit the affected articles within 10 days; pay any administrative amendment fee only if the objection is upheld.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trust Registry (Physical Window 3 or e-Services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the duly completed Form 1 (Application for Registration of an International Company) together with two copies of the Memorandum and Articles, the statutory declaration of the registered agent, and proof of payment of the USD 350 filing fee. The application must be signed by the registered agent on behalf of the subscriber and dated in the presence of a witness.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association (two stamped copies)
Statutory declaration of the registered agent
Consent letter of the registered office provider
Official receipt of government filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a Notice of Inquiry or Non-Compliance, the registered agent must rectify the stated deficiency within 14 days; failure results in automatic withdrawal which may be cured by re-lodgement without prejudice to the company name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following successful vetting, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company's exact name, registration number, date of incorporation, and the Registrar's seal. Verify the certificate for name spelling, date, and capacity wording. The registered agent then files the certificate with the company's statutory documents in the registered office file.
required_dossiers: Approved Form 1 application (registry copy)
Certificate of Incorporation (original issued by VFSC)
Registered agent's internal file opening form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical error, submit a Request for Administrative Correction (Form COR-4) with the original certificate for re-issuance within 5 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board governance, share allotment and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pass the first written board resolution adopting the registered office, appointing the first directors and officers (CEO, Company Secretary, Money-Laundering Reporting Officer), and approving the allotment of the initial ordinary shares. Issue share certificates to the subscriber, record transfers in the register of members, and open a corporate bank account with client escrow sub-account capability.
required_dossiers: First written board resolution (signed)
Share certificate(s) for initial subscriber
Register of members and register of directors
Officer consent and appointment letters
Bank account opening application with escrow/trust account mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointment is contested, hold an extraordinary general meeting to ratify or replace the officer; pass a supplemental board resolution and refile updated registers with the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign investment approval and business licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Foreign Investment Promotion Agency (VFIPA) and the Commissioner of Business Licences, Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the benficial owners are non-residents, submit a Foreign Investment Application to VFIPA under the Foreign Investment Act [Cap 340] for an International Consulting (Education and Migration) permit. Upon approval of the Foreign Investment Certificate, apply to the Commissioner of Business Licences for a Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 242], specifying the Port Vila registered business address and the scope 'study-abroad placement and immigration visa advisory services'. Display the licence at the registered office.
required_dossiers: VFIPA Application Form (Foreign Investment Application)
Business plan and projected revenue for the consulting activity
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum of Association
Passport copies of all foreign directors and shareholders
Approved Foreign Investment Certificate
Business Licence Application Form and annual licence fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFIPA issues an intention-to-refuse, submit additional evidence of local economic contribution within 21 days and request a review hearing before the VFIPA Review Committee; for a Business Licence refusal, correct the stated premises or scope and reapply within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Commissioner of Business Licences, Department of Finance and Treasury, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (with sector oversight by the Vanuatu Immigration Services, Ministry of Internal Affairs, and the Vanuatu Institute of Education Agent Certification)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (Category: Professional Services - International Student Placement and Migration/Immigration Visa Advisory) issued under the Business Licence Act [Cap 242], supplemented by a Labour/Visa Agent Engagement Permit issued by the Vanuatu Immigration Services under the Immigration (Fees and Forms) Regulations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Environment, Energy, Disaster Management and Meteorology
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Third Schedule Category B (office-based professional services); no full EIA Report required, only a de minimis environmental registration and self-declaration confirming no industrial discharge, no effluent generating process and no hazardous substance storage above the regulatory threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater and sewage discharges to municipal municipal septic systems must comply with the Water Resources Management Act [Cap 353] and the Urban Water Supply and Sewerage Act; no point-source industrial effluent, zero VOC-emitting processes; solid waste disposal only through licensed haulers under the Waste Management Regulations; office energy consumption expected to remain below 50 MWh per annum.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Rescue Services confirming emergency exits, extinguishers and evacuation routes; structural load and occupancy clearance from the Port Vila Municipality Building Inspectorate; occupational health and workplace clearance under the Occupational Health and Safety Regulations 2020 requiring first-aid kits, waste segregation and employee medical fit-for-duty records for all immigration-consulting staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), established under the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority Act No. 36 of 2011; unified administrator of the Value Added Tax Act No. 9 of 1998 [Cap 245], the Customs and Excise Management Act No. 11 of 2010 and stamp duties; official portal and e-services: https://www.vrca.gov.vu; customs declarations processed through ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Domestic path: a foreign entity with a Vanuatu taxable presence files the VRCA TIN registration form attaching the home-jurisdiction certificate of incorporation, notarised passport copies of directors, a board resolution appointing a local tax agent, evidence of registered physical address and a municipal business licence (where applicable); VRCA verifies the file and issues the TIN, and VAT registration is separately determined against the VT 4,000,000 turnover threshold. Offshore path: an International Company (IC) is incorporated by a VFSC-licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; the IC automatically receives tax-exempt status and is not required to obtain a TIN or VAT registration because the IC Act prohibits carrying on business with Vanuatu residents; the only annual obligation is the VFSC annual return filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — by operation of the International Companies Act [Cap 222], the VU_IC is an offshore juridical person exempt from all Vanuatu taxes (no income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, VAT or stamp duty on worldwide offshore activities); non-resident ownership is unrestricted; the exemption is automatic and requires no election, but the IC remains subject to VFSC annual filing and anti-money-laundering/beneficial-ownership substance obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, so no check-the-box entity classification and no hybrid-mismatch election is available; an IC cannot elect into the domestic VAT regime because the IC Act forbids supplies to Vanuatu residents; the only relevant corporate elections (conversion to a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap 191], change of registered agent or voluntary striking-off) do not create any tax election and would, in the case of conversion, forfeit the statutory tax-exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 9 of 1998 [Cap 245], administered by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA); functionally a consumption-style GST covering goods and services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 4,000,000 in annual taxable turnover (VAT Act [Cap 245] s. 4); registration becomes compulsory once taxable supplies exceed VT 4,000,000 in any consecutive 12-month period, equivalent to approximately USD 33,000 at prevailing VUV/USD market rates; non-resident suppliers of cross-border services to Vanuatu residents are outside the net unless the services are physically performed or exploited inside Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not operate a real-time e-invoicing, fiscal-clearance or digital-stamping mandate; VAT-registered suppliers must issue tax invoices carrying the supplier's name, TIN, VAT registration number, description and taxable value, VAT amount and supply date, and retain records for 7 years; imports are cleared electronically via ASYCUDA World, but no statutory API-based fiscal data transmission is required for domestic B2B or consumer invoicing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under VAT Act [Cap 245] s. 6 and Schedule 2 for: (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply and documented through customs; (ii) services supplied to non-resident recipients where the place of consumption and benefit is wholly outside Vanuatu and the services do not relate to land or goods situated in Vanuatu; and (iii) international transport and freight. For the ISIC 7810 study-abroad and immigration-visa consultancy, advisory and placement fees invoiced to overseas students, foreign universities and migration clients qualify for zero-rating provided the recipient is a non-resident, the services are performed offshore, and no domestic lodging, tutoring or relocation element is supplied in Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed through ASYCUDA World with VRCA clearance status
Commercial invoice and VAT tax invoice addressed to the foreign buyer or service recipient
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or postal despatch receipt evidencing physical export from Vanuatu (goods)
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by an authorised Vanuatu bank, or SWIFT MT103/telegraphic transfer credit advice, evidencing foreign-currency payment
Packing list, certificate of origin and export permit where applicable
For services: signed consultancy agreement, scope of work, student enrolment and visa-submission records demonstrating performance entirely outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA applies risk-based post-clearance and post-refund audits of exporters claiming zero-rating; deficient or fraudulent substantiation triggers repayment of the VAT previously refunded or credited together with statutory penalty tax and interest from the date of the erroneous claim; criminal prosecution for fraudulent zero-rating or false customs declarations may attract substantial fines and imprisonment; customs may seize and forfeit the goods, cancel exporter bonds and the VFSC may strike off the entity for non-compliance. Export proceeds must be repatriated through the Vanuatu banking system within 180 days; default triggers Reserve Bank of Vanuatu exchange-control sanctions and retrospective disallowance of the zero-rating; supporting records must be retained for 7 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the exchange-control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 112]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the licensing, AML/CFT and conduct supervisor of banks, financial dealers, and registered agents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu is a free-floating, fully convertible currency for current-account payments effected through RBV-authorised dealers; capital-account transfers by resident entities require an RBV-prescribed application, but the non-resident International Company is statutorily excluded from the exchange-control regime. Profit remittance and dividend repatriation to non-resident owners are unrestricted, subject only to the disbursing bank's AML/CFT checks and CRS self-certification; the IC's zero percent corporate and withholding tax status removes all tax-clearance friction, while the bank will require audit-grade evidence of accrued service revenue for a study-abroad and immigration-consulting account.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory surrender timeline: not applicable; mandatory conversion ratio: 0%. The VU_IC, being a non-resident international company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], may retain 100% of consulting and placement fees in any settlement currency in Vanuatu or offshore accounts. Authorised dealers are required to report prescribed cross-border transactions to the RBV in periodic exchange-control returns and to retain transaction records for seven years; no RBV licence or prior approval is needed to hold or spend foreign currency at the corporate level.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account (USD/AUD/VUV)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account (USD/AUD/VUV)
Operational Account (VUV) with limited offshore corporate product

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW as a primary treasury rail; MEDIUM only as an ancillary payment wallet for small client top-ups. Legal constraints: an offshore EMI not licensed by the VFSC may not solicit deposits or provide payment services in or from Vanuatu under the Financial Dealers Act [Cap 70] and the International Banking Act [Cap 163]; holding client funds in an unlicensed EMI is an automatic enhanced-risk flag at the local clearing bank and may breach the statutory client-money trust duty. A VFSC-licensed money changer or EMI can support low-value conversion, but escrow of student fees and the corporate treasury account must sit with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted at tier-1 banks for non-resident ICs: the standard pack includes certified passport copies, certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency, board resolution, CRS self-certification, and a video KYC interview with the bank's compliance officer. Physical attendance in Port Vila is not statutorily mandated for all directors, but an in-person signatory meeting will be required where enhanced due diligence is invoked (PEPs, high-risk counterparties, third-party funding) or where correspondent bank conditions mandate physical verification; the IC's registered agent in Vanuatu must certify the identity of all beneficial owners under the AML/CFT Act 2017.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity resulting from nominee shareholders or multi-layer offshore holding structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incumbency, chain-of-title share register, statutory beneficial-ownership declaration under the AML/CFT Act 2017, registered-agent attestation, source-of-wealth statement, and 12-month bank statements of ultimate beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party remittances by parents or sponsors funding student placements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed sponsorship declaration, copy of funder passport and three-month bank statement, itemised tuition invoice, enrolment confirmation from the education institution, and the service agreement between the funder and the VU_IC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lumpy transfers to government immigration and citizenship programme authorities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Government-issued agent appointment or authorisation letter, published official fee schedule, filed application forms with official receipts, regulatory licence of the VU_IC, and reconciliation of each wire to a named applicant file.

Screening results against UN/EU/OFAC sanctions lists, negative-media search results, portfolio risk-assessment memorandum, correspondent-bank clearance evidence, and a transaction-rationale note for each counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low substance and high-margin commission model inconsistent with declared revenue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vanuatu registered-office and lease agreements, employment contracts and payroll records, board minutes, annual audited financial statements (or exemption certificate), and the IC's tax-exempt status confirmation issued by the registered agent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Execute inbound remittances as SWIFT MT103 with the ordering customer named in field 50K, the Port Vila receiving bank in field 57, and field 70 narrative citing 'IC SHARE CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - STUDY ABROAD AND IMMIGRATION CONSULTANCY' plus the registered agent's client reference; charges should be OUR to ensure full credit. Verification pack: letter of source-of-funds from the sending bank, share subscription resolution, IC Register allotment entry, registered-agent certificate, and CRS self-certification; RBV pre-approval is not required for non-resident IC capital injections, and the receiving bank retains the records for seven years.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 for tuition disbursements and visa or authority fees under the bank's correspondent threshold (approximately USD 125,000 equivalent), using purpose narrative 'education service fees' and mandatory UN/EU/OFAC screening. For block-campaign or multi-student group placements, use an irrevocable sight letter of credit issued under UCP 600 by the Vanuatu authorised dealer, or a documentary collection (DP/DA) where the beneficiary institution requires dispatch evidence; any VUV-denominated obligation is converted through the authorised dealer at the RBV reference rate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright vanilla FX forwards (USD/AUD, USD/VUV) executed with an RBV-authorised dealer on documentation of underlying fee flows
Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD) matching fixed tuition and placement disbursement schedules
European-style FX options and zero-premium collars for inbound capital conversion exposure
FX swaps (spot-against-forward) for VUV/USD operational liquidity management
Non-deliverable forwards on VUV: permissible only on a non-deliverable, net-settled basis in USD or AUD through a licensed dealer, with no VUV delivery and prior disclosure to the dealing bank

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form IC-AR) with registered agent attestation and annual government renewal fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 21 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 25,000 (approx. USD 210) per month; continued default beyond 3 months triggers a VFSC notice of proposed strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC – Central Registry and AML/CFT Supervisory Unit (filed via registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days of the company's anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unfiled UBO declaration attracts AML penalty up to VT 500,000 (approx. USD 4,200); recurring non-compliance may result in suspension of any escrow or visa-related licence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Client Funds / Escrow Compliance Certification if holding immigration or study-abroad escrow funds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 6 months after financial year-end (financial year-end typically 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to certify triggers immediate suspension of escrow authorisation, referral to Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, and a fine of up to VT 1,000,000 (approx. USD 8,400).

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No universal statutory audit is imposed on Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act. A mandatory independent audit arises only where the entity holds a licensed escrow/trustee activity and holds client funds above VT 10,000,000 (approx. USD 84,000), or where VFSC/AML licence conditions require audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) for licensed and audited entities; simplified cash-basis internal records are otherwise sufficient for a non-resident, tax-exempt International Company.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must be notified of any share transfer and UBO change during the year. The annual return confirms the UBO schedule and is treated as a confidential filing. A licensed entity retaining client funds must additionally maintain an on-site current UBO register and submit a confidential annual UBO list to VFSC.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; an International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutorily tax-exempt on all foreign-source and domestic-source income except where a specific indirect tax applies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, interest withholding tax, royalty withholding tax and stamp duty on share transfers; no payroll tax on non-resident staff; remaining effective costs are limited to indirect obligations, i.e., 15% Value Added Tax (VAT) on locally consumed taxable supplies (exported consultancy services are zero-rated), annual VFSC licence fees, and Business Licence fees for any Vanuatu physical presence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies (prescribed under section 78 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]) filed through the VFSC e-Registry portal; VAT returns, where applicable, are filed with the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Administration under the VAT Act 1998 (as amended).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — anniversary-based; there is no annual corporate income tax return because no CIT is imposed. ICs file one annual return and pay the annual government fee. A separate annual Business Licence renewal applies only if a physical office exists in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and annual fee are due within 30 days after the anniversary date of the certificate of incorporation; the annual licence fee is due on the anniversary date. VAT returns, if the IC has local taxable supplies, are due according to the prescribed taxable period deadline under the VAT Act; exported study-abroad and immigration consultancy services are typically zero-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Company Name and VFSC Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company and the registration number appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact legal name from the Certificate of Incorporation; do not insert trade names, business signs, or abbreviations. Non-resident filers must ensure the registered agent confirms the name matches the VFSC register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Registered Office and Registered Agent in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu and the name of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be the office of the licensed registered agent within Vanuatu; a P.O. Box address is not acceptable as the registered office. Non-resident owners must use the agent's street address for all statutory correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Directors, Officers and Corporate Secretary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, residential addresses, nationalities, and dates of appointment of all directors, officers, and the corporate secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; each non-resident director must provide a signed consent and suitability declaration. Nominee directors must be disclosed with their appointing principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 — Share Capital, Share Classes and Shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised capital, issued shares, share class rights, and the register of registered shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited; every shareholding, including non-resident holdings, must be recorded in the share register. Confirm share premium and unpaid capital entries are correctly stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification identifying each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and the chain of ownership or control.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must hold certified passport, proof of address, and source of wealth for every non-resident UBO. The annual return confirms that the beneficial ownership register held by the agent is current and accurate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 — Economic Substance or Foreign Tax Residence Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual self-declaration of whether the IC is tax resident outside Vanuatu and whether it carries on a relevant activity through a permanent establishment in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-managed IC must state its foreign tax residence jurisdiction and, if required by VFSC guidance, provide evidence of foreign tax registration. If the IC claims a foreign tax residence, attach an accountant's or attorney's certificate identifying the foreign tax authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of the annual fee attracts a statutory late penalty of 10% of the overdue annual fee, plus accruing daily surcharges. Continued non-filing beyond the anniversary filing window permits the VFSC Registrar to strike the company off the International Companies Register; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, the late penalty, an additional restoration fee, and fresh directors' declarations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to resident or non-resident shareholders; dividend distributions from the tax-exempt IC are fully free of Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and no income tax administration capable of issuing an income tax residency certificate. Because Vanuatu imposes zero dividend withholding tax, treaty relief is not required for outbound dividends. If a foreign shareholder's residence jurisdiction requires documentary evidence, the standard protocol is: (i) obtain a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incorporation; (ii) obtain a signed letter from the IC's registered agent confirming Vanuatu tax-exempt status and absence of any Vanuatu tax withheld; and (iii) submit those documents to the foreign tax authority together with the shareholder's own tax return claim. No Vanuatu TRC filing procedure exists because no income tax law is in force.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for interest and IP royalties paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents; treaty rate: 0% (no applicable DTA reductions; the zero-rate is absolute under domestic law). Payments must still satisfy substance, beneficial ownership, and commercial reasonableness tests to avoid challenge in the recipient's residence jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File requirements, and no country-by-country reporting obligations. The operative compliance threshold is instead the VFSC Economic Substance declaration, which applies to all ICs irrespective of turnover; the threshold in local currency is therefore VUV 0 for TP documentation and 'any IC undertaking a relevant activity' for substance purposes.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable — Vanuatu enacted the International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2019 and associated Economic Substance Regulations, administered by VFSC. An IC carrying on a 'relevant activity' from a permanent establishment in Vanuatu must demonstrate economic substance: premises in Vanuatu, adequate full-time employees, sufficient local expenditure, and direction and management exercised in Vanuatu. For the ISIC 7810 study-abroad and golden visa advisory business, the relevant activity is most likely classified as a 'distribution and service centre'. An IC that is tax resident in a foreign jurisdiction is exempt from the Vanuatu substance test but must file an annual declaration identifying that jurisdiction and attach supporting evidence. Failure to file or to satisfy substance requirements results in administrative penalties, deregistration, and adverse information reporting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — Misuse of Zero-Tax Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing false declarations of foreign tax residence to VFSC to escape the economic substance test; using the tax-exempt IC to conceal foreign taxable service income; issuing zero-rated VAT invoices for study-abroad or immigration services that are in fact consumed in Vanuatu; knowingly underpaying VAT on local commissions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 (as amended), incorrect returns and evasion attract penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded plus interest; under the ESR Regulations, VFSC may impose substantial administrative fines, cancel the company's certificate of incorporation, and refer the matter for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and registered agents may face personal civil restitution of evaded amounts, asset freezing and travel bans or non-departure orders, and imprisonment of up to 7 years for fraud, forgery, or false declaration offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company — Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC with only a registered agent address and P.O. Box while performing a relevant service-centre activity (client sourcing, visa processing, tuition fee handling) from foreign staff; failing to maintain premises, employees, and expenditure in Vanuatu; failing to file the annual economic substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may issue compliance notices with escalating financial penalties, impose an economic substance assessment fee, deregister the IC for repeated default, and pass negative information to foreign exchange-of-information authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners may be ordered to restore assets, be disqualified as directors of any Vanuatu entity, and face travel restrictions pending compliance; deliberate concealment may lead to custodial sentence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Deficiency and Unlicensed Financial Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving client funds for tuition deposits, escrow accounts, and golden visa government fees without a compliant AML/CFT framework; absence of customer due diligence, source-of-funds verification, transaction monitoring, or suspicious transaction reporting; operating without the required Business Licence or failing to notify VFSC that the company is engaged in money or value transfer services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's AML/CFT Act and VFSC AML Rules, financial and conduct penalties may reach VUV 25,000,000 (approximately USD 210,000); the business licence may be suspended or revoked, and money laundering offences carry custodial penalties of up to 15 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally exposed to civil restitution to defrauded clients, licence prohibition, travel bans pending investigation, and imprisonment for money laundering, dishonest receipt of client funds, or conspiracy to defraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Client-Fund Misuse — Escrow Conversion in Visa Transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Commingling client tuition payments, visa application fees, and escrow monies with the IC's operating account; authorising disbursement of escrow funds before visa approval or service completion; using client funds for working capital; failing to maintain separate client ledgers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil claims for breach of fiduciary duty, professional licence cancellation by the Vanuatu Business Licence Office, restitutionary orders equal to the full amount misapplied, and criminal charges under the penal code for obtaining money by deception.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil applies directly: directors and shareholders who controlled the funds are jointly and severally liable for restitution; travel bans may be imposed to secure assets; conviction can result in imprisonment of up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Abandoning the IC without formal deregistration; failing to pay annual VFSC fees; failing to file annual returns; leaving assets, client money, and contractual obligations unresolved; allowing the entity to be struck off while liabilities remain outstanding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off from the International Companies Register; restoration requires a court order or VFSC consent, payment of arrears, penalties, and restoration fees; creditors may seek appointment of a liquidator against the struck-off company's assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu company; civil restitution orders can attach to personal assets; travel bans may be issued pending repayment; fraudulent abandonment with intent to defraud creditors carries custodial penalties.
